authority: docs/MASTER_END_TO_END_PLAN.md is authoritative for content; this file is authoritative for scheduling, scope assignment and gate commands. docs/OPERATION_TRACEABILITY.md is authoritative for per-operation state.
objective: Build the complete backend and integration layer for the six pinned Enatega apps, prove it with unit, real-stack integration, journey, Playwright and native device evidence, and keep per-operation coverage enforced from the first change.
invariants: Integer minor currency units and server-owned pricing
No card data and no embedded provider secrets in clients
Sandbox providers explicitly named and disabled in production
No mock success and no production fallback to upstream endpoints

decisions.default: Waves 0-4 deliver the 263 multivendor operations; the 71 single-vendor roots stay NOT_IMPLEMENTED until Wave 5 is approved
Core-plan food commission fixed at 0%; non-core plans not offered
PENDING auto-cancel after ORDER_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (120); unclaimed ACCEPTED flagged, never auto-cancelled

Email/SMS/push through ports; DevOutbox only in development/test

Web uses same-origin HttpOnly BFF cookies; native uses platform secure storage with short-lived access tokens
Playwright: chromium required, firefox/webkit best effort
Native harness: Maestro on signed builds
Vendor web packages install with a per-package .npmrc that relaxes engine-strict under Node 24; pinned manifests untouched
Extend the customer-web configuration query with vapidKey as a recorded vendor edit
Keep client-side AES-GCM config decryption with the public NEXT_PUBLIC_* key and stop treating it as secrecy
All three web apps use the BFF cookie session bridge
Public-access gate stays HTTP-only; bop-auth is verified on WebSocket only when a client supplies it, and per-subscription authorisation remains the control
x-skip-public-auth is not honoured by the server; enforcement is controlled only by PUBLIC_ACCESS_ENFORCED
